settings.title: Electronics curated for calmer, clearer everyday living.
settings.body: Astranova is a premium-tech storefront built around trust, clarity and a tighter catalog. Instead of feeling crowded, the store is designed to help customers understand what matters fast: what a product does, who it fits, how it ships and why it is worth buying.

settings.title: Four clear product lines instead of endless noise
settings.body: Astranova begins with audio, mobile accessories, desk setup and smart gadgets so the storefront feels focused and premium from the first click.

settings.title: Specs, compatibility and warranty appear before doubt sets in
settings.body: Each product page is meant to answer practical questions quickly with benefit bullets, technical detail and visible shipping guidance.

settings.title: Estonia-facing support with wider EU confidence built in
settings.body: The brand voice stays calm and direct while the storefront supports English, Estonian and Russian for the moments where clarity matters most.

settings.title: A smaller catalog can feel more premium when the presentation is deliberate.
settings.body: Astranova is organized to reduce hesitation and make every product line easier to trust.
